justifications.c1: Per-incident costs are sourced but below ~£2k: £800 to replace a stolen bank (letsrecycle, search-confirmed), up to £1,000 (Sensolus, vendor) and up to £1,500 (TRA via Examiner); the £15m and £50m sector figures are aggregates from 2011–2018.
justifications.c2: About 750 banks stolen in early 2018 (Civil Society, search-confirmed; the page says 'over the past year', other coverage says Jan–Mar), TRAID lost 20 banks in two months, and SATCoL visits banks 'regularly, often daily' (Essex Police, search-confirmed); thefts per individual bank are rarer.
justifications.c3: Documented routines: fixed and often daily collection rounds, SmartWater marking, GPS trackers and bank redesign; major charities spend ~20% of income on logistics and an Oxfam trial showed up to 30% route savings (Southampton), though per-bank labour cost is not given.
justifications.c4: No regulation, licence, insurer condition or host-site clause requiring monitoring was found (recorded not found); pressure is only council removals of unauthorised banks and a ministerial 'zero tolerance' pledge.
justifications.c5: SATCoL (thousands of banks) is a real buyer that piloted sensors on 104 banks in 2016, but the job-role evidence is a generic listing with unconfirmed mapping, and budgets are shrinking (WRAP: collectors operating at a loss; SATCoL cutting its network).
justifications.c6: Only an integrator (Peak Technologies supplying Sensolus to TRAID) and direct vendor sales (Sensoneo) are shown; no bank manufacturer, textile merchant or host site bundling sensors was found.
justifications.c7: Crowded: Nordsense, Sensoneo, FarSite, Sensority and Sensolus already serve clothing banks (Nordsense already senses fill plus movement), none priced; SATCoL's 2016 trial did not lead to evidenced roll-out, and the market collapsed in 2025–26.
justifications.c8: Comparable devices exist (Nordsense 134 g Cat-M1, Sensoneo ultrasonic with under-5-minute install, GNSS trackers recovering banks), but no BOM or component prices were gathered and steel banks may attenuate signals.
justifications.c9: Value recurs with each collection round, but there is no record-keeping duty, no subscription price for any comparable product, and the sector's falling prices weaken willingness to pay.
justifications.c10: Three independent source types: police enforcement (Essex Police release, search-confirmed; City of London arrests), trade press (letsrecycle, Resource, Civil Society) and resident complaints (FixMyStreet, Ealing News, Yorkshire Post).

weakest: No compliance driver, a crowded vendor field (Nordsense, Sensoneo, FarSite, Sensolus) and loss-making buyers who are shrinking their bank networks.
